command.name: Radiant Wings
verbatim: Each Round: 30% chance to increase your Instinct and Initiative by +20% for 1 round(s).
Rounds 1, 2, 4, 7: Deal Tactical Damage to 1 Enemy in the same lane (Damage Rate: +50%).
Rounds 2, 5, 8: Apply Recovery to 2 Allies within adjacency (Rate: +30%, enhanced by Initiative).
At 6+ Stars Rounds 1, 2: Increase the Tactical Damage Rate to +100%, and increase the Recovery Rate to +60%.

vanguard.name: Sentinel's Presence
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard Increase your Recovery Dealt by +15% and Instinct by +25. Increase Fire Damage Dealt by +16% of the Ally deployed in the Left Flank.

habits.name: Tactical Inferno
habits.verbatim: Start of Round 1: Increase the Tactical Damage Dealt of 1 Ally in any lane (prioritizes the Left Flank) and the Fire Damage Dealt of 1 Ally in any lane (prioritizes the Right Flank) by +9% for 3 round(s).

habits.name: Unbroken Devotion
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase Recovery Received by +15% of 2 other Allies in any lane until the end of combat.

habits.name: Sunbreak
habits.verbatim: Radiant Wings gains: Rounds 1, 2: Increase the Tactical Damage Rate to +100%, and increase the Recovery Rate to +60%.

habits.name: Wind's Favor
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase Initiative by +8% (enhanced by Initiative) of 3 Allies in any lane until the end of combat.

habits.name: First Light
habits.verbatim: Start of Round 1: Increase Intelligence and Instinct (enhanced by Initiative) by +5% of 3 Allies in any lane for 3 round(s). Start of Rounds 1-3: 20% chance to grant First-Strike to 2 other Allies in any lane until the end of the round.
